blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – A total of 104 families displaced by a fire in Barangay Labogon, Mandaue City, received additional assistance from the office of Senator Christopher “Bong” Go during his visit to the affected community on Wednesday, November 4. Go personally led the distribution of grocery packs, financial assistance, basketballs, and volleyballs to the fire victims. School supplies were also provided to children. The senator with other officials also joined the residents for a boodle fight during the activity.
